serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
…
She really is in a bad mood…
I feel very uncomfortable around her today. It must be something more than just me being a bother during her free time.
At least that’s what I think.
But why would she be so distressed? Is it something I said or done?
I don’t think so. Since I met her today, I have tried to be as nice and polite as possible.
Well, it’s not like it matters that much, she just needs to fill in the report and that’s it. Someone else will probably take care of this case anyway later on.
On the other hand, she’s the cop taking care of my neighborhood, so I wouldn’t want to have a beef with her.
Alright, when she’s back I will try to talk it out with her. 
But there is one thing that bothers me.
She mentioned something about not having any information about a nun. 
It sure sounded like she already knew something about this. Maybe Shanice’s parents reported her disappearance?
That police woman is quite some time there already so she will be back any minute now. I will ask her about it then.
